items.fullMessage:
User Guide and GUI rewording (#20962)

Link to issue number:

None
Summary of the issue:

Some wording in the GUI and in the User Guide could lead to confusion and / or be improved:

    It is not clear in GUI that "Native selection mode" setting only applies to when page is loaded; e.g. if you change it through NVDA+shift+f10, this won't change the value found when opening the settings dialog.
    The User Guide provide too many technical details regarding the allowed 15mm margin to detect an edge gesture.

Description of user facing changes:

User Guide reworded and GUI label updated.
Description of developer facing changes:

N/A
Description of development approach:

    In browse mode settings, "Native selection mode" has been reworded to "Native selection mode on page load" to indicate that this only controls the selection mode when page are initially loaded, not later. The User Guide has been updated consistently too.

    Removed any explicit mention of the 15mm edge margin definition in the User Guide; replaced with a more user friendly wording (e.g. gestures starting from edge) as we can find in other screen reader documentations (e.g. Android)
